subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 2/4] exports: Add read_io= and write_io= export options

2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch adds support for read_io= and write_io= options in the exports file, which allow specifying I/O modes for NFS exports. The patch introduces new fields e_read_io and e_write_io to store these values, and updates various parts of the code to handle them correctly. It also includes checks to ensure that kernels without I/O mode attributes can still use the export system, and adds warnings when such kernels are encountered. The patch modifies several files in the nfs-utils package, including configure.ac, support/export/cache.c, and others.
